integrity: Standalone graph-enumeration checker with exact rational arithmetic corroborates the finite cases; the theorem is justified by the included symbolic decomposition and concentration argument, not by finite experiments.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the two-hub complete bipartite family with independent common orientation bias. The exponential total-variation asymptotic assumes fixed interior bias or a compact interior interval; no result for p tending to zero or one with n. Earlier equivalent evaluations may exist outside the inspected literature; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: A signed binomial correction for directed reachability on \(K_{2,n}\)
